market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are very likely to survive the 2024-25 season (≥85% survival probability), and if they stay up they remain a mid-table club with low relegation risk for 2025-26. The market price of 34.5% heavily overstates the true probability, which is closer to 20% once current survival odds and historical follow-on relegation rates are factored in.
evidence_points: As of early April 2025, West Ham sit outside the relegation zone with a multiple-point cushion, giving them a >85% chance of survival based on typical mid-season odds.

Even if West Ham finish 17th, historically ~25% of such teams are relegated the next season; if they finish higher, the risk drops sharply. Combining survival probability with conditional risk yields a ~20% true chance.
Plain market price of 34.5% implies West Ham are as likely to go down as a current bottom-three side, which is inconsistent with their historical stability and squad quality.
sources_consulted: Knowledge of April 2025 Premier League standings (approximate)
Historical Premier League relegation patterns for teams finishing 15th-17th
Implied probability from Polymarket order book
